_note: Provisional picks (2026-10-13): transcription-checked, accent not yet judged by a human. Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice via VoiceStudio; never send 'language'. 2026-10-14: this engine IGNORES the 'instructions' text (same seed + other instructions = byte-identical audio; studio/voice_take.py probes this once per voice/model and caches the answer in work/_voice_probe.json). The field is kept for other engines but nothing relies on it. The pitch register comes from the SEED, so the whole script is voiced in ONE request and a take that is not steady is re-rolled with the next seed. ref_f0_hz = median pitch of the sample the user listened to (ref_sample, measured with 'python3 studio/voice_take.py refs'); every take must land within 3 semitones of it. 2026-10-14 (German): 'de' is voiced by its OWN engine, Thorsten-Voice/Kokoro (Apache-2.0, dataset CC0), a small server in voice-de/ (start it with voice-de/run.sh start). engine_url = where the speech request goes; transcription (the per-line voice check) stays on VoiceStudio. deterministic = the same text gives the same audio, so the pipeline makes ONE take and never re-rolls seeds or patches lines: a line that fails the voice check has to be reworded. The Aiden voice (Qwen3, English-native) failed whole scripts (24 seeds: de-funkuhr, de-noise-cancelling).
